description: This Python script provides utility functions for fetching, caching, and processing test-related data, including test times, test class times, disabled tests, and profiling information, primarily for use in CI/CD pipelines and test infrastructure management.

methods.name: get_disabled_issues
methods.description: Retrieves a list of issue numbers that are disabled or re-enabled based on environment variables.

methods.name: fetch_and_cache
methods.description: Fetches data from a URL, caches it locally, and processes it with a provided function, with cache validation based on file modification time.

methods.name: get_test_times
methods.description: Retrieves test timing data from a remote source or cache.

methods.name: get_test_class_times
methods.description: Retrieves test class timing data from a remote source or cache.

methods.name: get_disabled_tests
methods.description: Downloads and processes a list of disabled tests, filtering out re-enabled ones.

methods.name: get_td_heuristic_historial_edited_files_json
methods.description: Retrieves heuristic profiling data related to historical edited files.

methods.name: copy_pytest_cache
methods.description: Copies the last failed pytest cache to an additional CI files folder.

methods.name: copy_additional_previous_failures
methods.description: Copies previous failure data to an additional CI files folder.

methods.name: get_from_test_infra_generated_stats
methods.description: Fetches and caches test infrastructure generated statistics from a remote URL.
